paragraphs: [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3094&lang=en) cites [Kiddushin 30a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.30a.1); the text Hyman uses reads: “Rava said to Rav Natan bar Ami.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman reads Rava as addressing Rav Natan bar Ami. The linked Bavli has the same direction, with the title Rabbi for Natan.
Heilprin instead makes Rava bar Natan bar Ami the speaker and has him address Rava.
